purpose: Encoding-only lossless size reductions of six independently reconstructed normal preview GIFs. No runtime, scene, timeline, palette colors, displayed pixels or original render baseline changed.
historical_baseline_policy: The original v0.1.2 encoded media hashes remain preserved as historical evidence. The replacement GIF hashes are recorded separately here. Source/runtime and decoded-render regression anchors must remain unchanged.

tools.ffmpeg: ffmpeg version 7.1.5-0+deb13u1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

method: Decode each GIF to exact RGB/RGBA; palette-exact Pillow re-encoding with minimal changed rectangles and lossless transparency of unchanged pixels; retain every frame and delay; disposal changes from full-frame clearing to retain. An opaque full first frame resets every loop. No frame merging or timing resampling.

digest_definitions.rgba_sha256: SHA-256 of width*height*4 bytes, row-major RGBA, from each fully composited displayed frame decoded by Pillow
digest_definitions.rgba_delay_sequence_sha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON array of [frame_index,rgba_sha256,duration_ms], serialized with compact separators and no trailing newline
digest_definitions.ffmpeg_framehash_sha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 ffmpeg non-comment framehash lines joined with newline and one final newline; lines include stream,DTS,PTS,duration,uncompressed byte size and SHA-256 RGBA frame hash
digest_definitions.ffmpeg_verification_command: ffmpeg -v error -xerror -i INPUT.gif -vsync 0 -pix_fmt rgba -f framehash -hash sha256 -
